answer.answer: Only four qualifying pairs exist (Caldwell 2019/2020 in the Mediterranean and the three Kalangutkar Arabian-Sea studies), giving factors of 7.77, 1.72, 4.05 and 2.35, for a median factor of about 3.2. Mesh size differs between some paired studies (100 vs 300 µm) and sampling sites, while close, are not identical, so the figure reflects both natural variability and minor method/location mismatches.
